<!-- Adding or correcting papers? You only need to edit data/papers.csv. -->

**What changed**
- [ ] Added paper(s)
- [ ] Corrected labels or metadata (please cite the paper section or page)
- [ ] Site or pipeline change

**Checklist for data changes**
- [ ] Each new row has `key`, `title`, `year`, `url`, `category`, `pillars`, `summary`
- [ ] The four chart labels are filled, or `annotation_source` is `pending`
- [ ] `python scripts/check_papers.py` passes (it also runs automatically below)
